payload.title: CLI: edit doctrine records and update sections (papyrus sections doctrine set / sections update)
payload.description: Agent parity: editors edit the publication mission/policy doctrine Items and NewsroomSection policy, guidance and kill criteria in Administration; agents have no CLI and fall back to raw GraphQL (Item.update, updateNewsroomSection). Add 'papyrus sections doctrine set --kind mission|policy --file <md>' and 'papyrus sections update --id <id> [--editorial-policy-file ...] [--assignment-guidance-file ...] [--kill-criteria-file ...]' using the same mutations the newsroom uses.
